name: Patel
source:
The owner of Pacifica's favorite café. It's reasonable prices and relaxing atmosphere have made it a favorite of Sayoko's group's as well.
Standing out as one of the only ghosts in town with a darker complexion, he carries a sense of individuality and confidence that makes him particularly popular among his customers.
